description: This Java class defines a mock device cluster for temperature configuration in a Zigbee-like environment, including attributes and event handling for high temperature alarms.

classes.name: MockDeviceTemperatureConfigurationCluster
classes.description: A mock device cluster representing temperature configuration, including high temperature alarm state and associated event handling.

methods.name: isTemperatureHigh
methods.description: Returns whether the temperature is currently considered high.

methods.name: setTemperatureHigh
methods.description: Sets the high temperature state and triggers an alarm event if the state changes.

methods.name: getAttributeData
methods.description: Retrieves the byte array representation of the specified attribute.

methods.name: setAttributeData
methods.description: Sets attribute data, currently a no-op returning success.
